resources.string: Configure your FastAPI backend URL. By default, the app connects to the production Cloud HTTPS backend so it works anywhere without shared Wi-Fi. You may also connect to a local development machine.

Preset Defaults:
• Public Cloud (Works Anywhere): https://smart-blind-stick.onrender.com/app
• Real Phone on Wi-Fi: http://[PC_LAN_IP]:8000/app
• Android Emulator: http://10.0.2.2:8000/app

Connection Guidance:\n• Cloud Deployment: Works anywhere from any cellular or Wi-Fi network.\n• Local Development: If running FastAPI on your PC/laptop, phone and laptop must share local Wi-Fi (e.g. http://192.168.1.100:8000/app) or use USB reverse port forwarding.
